title: RDS, Aurora or DynamoDB: reading the clues in order

questions.ask: Is every access by a known key, at very large or unpredictable scale, with no servers to manage?
Must an existing Oracle, SQL Server, Db2 or MariaDB database keep its engine?
Relational, with a promotable secondary in another Region?
Intermittent, unpredictable load on a relational database?
MySQL or PostgreSQL that needs fast failover, up to 15 replicas or self-growing storage?

otherwise: Standard RDS for MySQL or PostgreSQL: valid and cheaper
caption: Ask from the top; the first yes decides. Joins and flexible queries mean relational, transactions alone do not.
